# DevExpress Office File API Skills

AI agent skills for [DevExpress Office File API](https://www.devexpress.com/products/net/office-file-api/) - headless .NET document processing libraries for Spreadsheet, Word, PDF, Presentation, Barcode, ZIP, and related automation scenarios.

All skills target DevExpress v26.1. The `devexpress-office-file-api-pdf-new` skill covers the new PDF API in CTP status.

## Skills

| Skill | Covers | Docs |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [devexpress-office-file-api-spreadsheet](devexpress-office-file-api-spreadsheet/) | Spreadsheet Document API: workbooks, formulas, formatting, charts, pivot tables, import/export, protection | [SKILL.md](devexpress-office-file-api-spreadsheet/SKILL.md) |
| [devexpress-office-file-api-word-processing](devexpress-office-file-api-word-processing/) | Word Processing API: documents, paragraphs, tables, styles, mail merge, export | [SKILL.md](devexpress-office-file-api-word-processing/SKILL.md) |
| [devexpress-office-file-api-pdf](devexpress-office-file-api-pdf/) | Legacy PDF API (`PdfDocumentProcessor`): creation, manipulation, forms, annotations, security | [SKILL.md](devexpress-office-file-api-pdf/SKILL.md) |
| [devexpress-office-file-api-pdf-new](devexpress-office-file-api-pdf-new/) | New PDF API (`DevExpress.Docs.Pdf`, CTP): DOM-based create/edit/secure/print workflows | [SKILL.md](devexpress-office-file-api-pdf-new/SKILL.md) |

| [devexpress-office-file-api-barcode](devexpress-office-file-api-barcode/) | Barcode API: QR, Data Matrix, Code 128, Aztec, and other symbologies | [SKILL.md](devexpress-office-file-api-barcode/SKILL.md) |
| [devexpress-office-file-api-unit-conversion](devexpress-office-file-api-unit-conversion/) | Unit Conversion API: metric/imperial conversions across common unit families | [SKILL.md](devexpress-office-file-api-unit-conversion/SKILL.md) |
| [devexpress-office-file-api-excel-export](devexpress-office-file-api-excel-export/) | Excel Export Library: streaming `.xlsx` generation for large datasets | [SKILL.md](devexpress-office-file-api-excel-export/SKILL.md) |

## Layout

Each skill folder contains:

- `SKILL.md` - activators, rules, and navigation guidance
- `references/` - feature-specific implementation guides
- `examples/quickstart.cs` - runnable quickstart sample
